## Visualizando funciones {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

_CR = '#c0392b'
_BL = '#2980b9'
_GO = 'goldenrod'
_GR = '#0000004a'

_xp = np.linspace(-2, 2, 300)
_yp = _xp**2

_th = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 300)
_xc = np.cos(_th)
_yc = 2 + np.sin(_th)

_xs = np.linspace(0, 2, 200)
_ys_p = np.sqrt(_xs)
_ys_n = -np.sqrt(_xs)

def _ax_par(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 4.3)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.set_xlabel('X', color=_GR, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Y', color=_GR, fontsize=11, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    for s in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    for s in ['bottom', 'left']:
        ax.spines[s].set_color(_GR)
    ax.tick_params(colors=_GR, labelsize=9)

def _ax_sq(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2.3, 2.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-1.7, 1.7)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1])
    ax.set_xlabel('X', color=_GR, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Y', color=_GR, fontsize=11, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    for s in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    for s in ['bottom', 'left']:
        ax.spines[s].set_color(_GR)
    ax.tick_params(colors=_GR, labelsize=9)
```

## ¿Qué es una función? {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3em 1em 2em; gap: 1.2em; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="font-size: 2.8em;"}
${\color{goldenrod}y} = {\color{#c0392b}f}({\color{teal}x})$
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.9em; font-size: 1.1em; max-width: 55em; line-height: 1.6;"}

::: {style="color: teal; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.15em;"}
Punto sutil:
:::

::: {style="color: navy;"}
[$f$]{style="color: #c0392b; font-style: italic;"} es la(s) regla(s) que mapea variables independientes ([$x$]{style="color: teal;"}) hacia variables dependientes ([$y$]{style="color: goldenrod;"}).
:::

::: {style="color: goldenrod;"}
[$y$]{style="font-style: italic;"} es un valor particular de la salida de una función para un valor particular de [$x$]{style="color: teal;"}.
:::

:::

:::

## Dominio y rango {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3em 1em 2em; gap: 2.2em; font-size: 1.15em;"}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.2em;"}
::: {style="flex: 0 0 9em; color: #888; font-style: italic; text-align: right; font-size: 1.05em;"}
Dominio:
:::
::: {style="flex: 1; color: goldenrod; line-height: 1.5;"}

```{python}
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

## Dominio y rango en asbtracto {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse, Circle

# Colores
_CR_A = '#b34533'   # terracota — dominio
_BL_A = '#1a3a9e'   # azul oscuro — rango
_GO_A = '#c89020'   # dorado — "Todo x"
_TL_A = '#00897b'   # teal — "Todo y" y flecha

# Geometría de cajas (coordenadas normalizadas 0-1)
_LBX, _LBY, _LBW, _LBH = 0.04, 0.10, 0.34, 0.78
_RBX, _RBY, _RBW, _RBH = 0.62, 0.10, 0.34, 0.78
_PAD = 0.022

def _make_frame_ab():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.5))
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.axis('off')
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (_LBX, _LBY), _LBW, _LBH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.025", lw=2.8, ls=(0, (5, 4)),
        ec=_GO_A, fc='none', zorder=1))
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (_RBX, _RBY), _RBW, _RBH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.025", lw=2.8, ls=(0, (5, 4)),
        ec=_TL_A, fc='none', zorder=1))
    ax.text(_LBX+0.01, _LBY+_LBH-0.01, 'Todo x',
            fontsize=14, color=_GO_A, style='italic', fontweight='bold',
            va='top', ha='left', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_RBX+_RBW-0.01, _RBY+_RBH-0.01, 'Todo y',
            fontsize=14, color=_TL_A, style='italic', fontweight='bold',
            va='top', ha='right', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_LBX+_LBW/2, _LBY-0.04, r'$D(f)$',
            fontsize=12, color=_CR_A, ha='center', va='top', style='italic', zorder=5)
    ax.text(_RBX+_RBW/2, _RBY-0.04, r'$R(f)$',
            fontsize=12, color=_TL_A, ha='center', va='top', style='italic', zorder=5)
    return fig, ax

def _filled_rect_ab(ax, bx, by, bw, bh, frac_y0, frac_y1, color):
    y0 = by + bh * frac_y0 + _PAD
    y1 = by + bh * frac_y1 - _PAD
    if y1 - y0 <= 0:
        return
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx+_PAD, y0), bw-2*_PAD, y1-y0,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.018", lw=0,
        ec='none', fc=color, zorder=2))

def _arrow_ab(ax, src, dst, formula, rad=-0.28):
    ax.annotate('', xy=dst, xytext=src,
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=_TL_A, lw=3.0,
                        connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}'), zorder=6)
    mx = (src[0]+dst[0])/2
    my = (src[1]+dst[1])/2 + 0.11
    ax.text(mx, my, formula, fontsize=13, color=_TL_A,
            ha='center', va='bottom', style='italic', zorder=6)
```

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.3em 1em;"}

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="width: 100%; height: 100%;"}
```{python}
#| echo: false
# Estado 0: f(x) = x² — dominio=ℝ (caja izq completa), rango=[0,∞) (parte superior derecha)
fig, ax = _make_frame_ab()
_filled_rect_ab(ax, _LBX, _LBY, _LBW, _LBH, 0.0, 1.0, _CR_A)
_filled_rect_ab(ax, _RBX, _RBY, _RBW, _RBH, 0.44, 1.0, _BL_A)
_arrow_ab(ax, (_LBX+_LBW+0.01, _LBY+_LBH*0.78),
              (_RBX-0.01, _RBY+_RBH*0.78), r'$y = f(x) = x^2$')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.show()
```

## Intuición Geómetrica: Funciones lineales vs no lineales {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.2em 1em;"}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
x = np.linspace(-3, 4, 600)

# No lineales
y_cr  = 0.62 * np.exp(-0.75 * (x + 0.4)**2) + 0.04 * x      # curva gaussiana (crimson)
y_sin = 0.52 * np.sin(2.3 * x)                                 # onda sinusoidal (teal)

# Lineales
y_bl = 0.13 * x + 0.22                                         # recta azul suave
y_go = 0.40 * x + 0.02                                         # recta dorada más inclinada

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8, 5.4))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Líneas de referencia punteadas
ax.axvline(x=-0.45, color='gray', lw=1.0, ls='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.axhline(y=0.22,  color='gray', lw=1.0, ls='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)

# Funciones no lineales
ax.plot(x, y_cr,  color=_CR,       lw=2.3, zorder=3)
ax.plot(x, y_sin, color='teal',    lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Funciones lineales
ax.plot(x, y_bl,  color='#2475b0', lw=2.3, zorder=3)          # azul
ax.plot(x, y_go,  color='goldenrod', lw=2.3, zorder=3)         # dorado
ax.axvline(x=1.55, color='navy',   lw=2.3, zorder=3)           # vertical navy

ax.set_xlim(-3, 4)
ax.set_ylim(-0.82, 0.88)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
plt.show()
```
:::

## Definición Algebraica #1: Lineal vs nolineal {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 1em 3.5em 1em 2em; gap: 1.5em;"}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; flex: 0 0 auto;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; border-left: 4px solid goldenrod; padding-left: 1em;"}
[**Lineal:**]{style="color: goldenrod; font-size: 1.05em;"} La función puede simplificarse a

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0; text-align: center;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = {\color{goldenrod}m}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}b}$$
:::
:::

::: {style="flex: 1; border-left: 4px solid #c0392b; padding-left: 1em;"}
[**No lineal:**]{style="color: #c0392b; font-size: 1.05em;"} La función **NO** puede simplificarse a

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0; text-align: center;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{#c0392b}m}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{#c0392b}b}$$
:::
:::

:::

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0;"}

::: {style="width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 8em;"}
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1;"}
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{teal}x}{\color{#c0392b}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4{\color{teal}x}$$
:::

:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 2.5em; align-items: flex-start; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 2\sqrt{\cos({\color{teal}x})} + 6$$
:::

:::

::: {style="flex: 1; text-align: center;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{#c0392b}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4$$
:::

:::

:::

:::

:::

La función puede simplificarse a

No lineal:
:::

::: {style="flex: 1;"}
La función **NO** puede simplificarse a

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{#c0392b}m}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{#c0392b}b}$$

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding-top: 0.8em;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = 2{\color{teal}x} + 6$$

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = 2\sqrt{\cos({\color{teal}x})} + 6$$
:::

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = 3{\color{teal}x}^2 - 4$$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: white; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding-top: 0.8em;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.4em 0;"}
$${\color{goldenrod}y} = \sqrt{2}{\color{teal}x} + \cos(6)$$
:::

:::

:::

:::

## Definición Algebraica #1-b-: Lineal vs nolineal {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.8em 3.5em 0.8em 1.5em; gap: 2em; align-items: flex-start;"}

:::

::: {style="flex: 1; margin: -0.4em 0;"}

## Funciones con subdominios lineales {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0.3em 3.5em 0.3em 1em;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 7.0))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)

_gold = '#b8860b'
_dash = '#aaaaaa'

def _ax_clean(ax):
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    for s in ax.spines.values():
        s.set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])

_ax_clean(ax1)
_ax_clean(ax2)

# LEFT: piecewise — segmento recto luego segmento curvo
xb1 = 0.3
xl1 = np.linspace(-2.4, xb1, 250)
yl1 = 1.1 * xl1 - 0.2
yb1 = 1.1 * xb1 - 0.2
xc1 = np.linspace(xb1, 2.2, 300)
yc1 = yb1 + 1.1*(xc1 - xb1) + 1.5*(xc1 - xb1)**2
ax1.plot(xl1, yl1, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax1.plot(xc1, yc1, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax1.axhline(yb1, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax1.axvline(xb1, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax1.set_xlim(-2.6, 2.5)
ax1.set_ylim(-3.0, 6.0)

# RIGHT: dos rectas con pendientes distintas, sin curvas
xb2 = 0.0
xl2 = np.linspace(-2.5, xb2, 250)
yl2 = 0.6 * xl2 - 0.15
yb2 = 0.6 * xb2 - 0.15
xr2 = np.linspace(xb2, 2.5, 250)
yr2 = yb2 + 2.5 * (xr2 - xb2)
ax2.plot(xl2, yl2, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax2.plot(xr2, yr2, color=_gold, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
ax2.axhline(yb2, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax2.axvline(xb2, color=_dash, ls='--', lw=0.9)

plt.tight_layout(pad=1.5)
plt.show()
```

:::

## Funciones lineales vs afines {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.5em 3.5em 0.5em 1.5em; gap: 1.5em; align-items: center;"}

::: {style="flex: 0 0 58%;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
ax.set_facecolor('none')
for s in ax.spines.values():
    s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_yticks([])

x = np.linspace(-2.5, 3.0, 300)

# Lineal: pasa por el origen
ax.plot(x, 1.8*x, color='#c0392b', lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Afín: no pasa por el origen (desplazada)
ax.plot(x, 0.65*x + 1.2, color='#b8860b', lw=2.3, zorder=3)

# Líneas de referencia punteadas en el origen
ax.axhline(0, color='#aaaaaa', ls='--', lw=0.9)
ax.axvline(0, color='#aaaaaa', ls='--', lw=0.9)

ax.set_xlim(-2.5, 3.0)
ax.set_ylim(-4.0, 5.0)
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.show()
```

## ¿Que son los polinomios? {.title-line}

::: {.r-stack style="width: 100%; height: 100%; padding-right: 3.5em;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em;font-size: 1.35em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{goldenrod}a_0} + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em;"}

[**Coeficientes**]{style="color: goldenrod; font-size: 0.9em; letter-spacing: 0.05em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_0}} + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_1}}{\color{teal}x} + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_2}}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + \boxed{{\color{goldenrod}a_n}}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=2 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4em;"}

$${\color{#c0392b}y} = {\color{goldenrod}a_0} + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

$$= {\color{goldenrod}a_0}{\color{teal}x}^0 + {\color{goldenrod}a_1}{\color{teal}x}^1 + {\color{goldenrod}a_2}{\color{teal}x}^2 + \ldots + {\color{goldenrod}a_n}{\color{teal}x}^n$$

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=3}

$$= \sum_{i=0}^{n} {\color{goldenrod}a_i}{\color{teal}x}^i$$

:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=4 style="background: white; width: 100%; min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.8em;"}

$$f({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}3} - {\color{goldenrod}5}{\color{teal}x} + \frac{{\color{goldenrod}5}}{6}{\color{teal}x}^2 + {\color{goldenrod}12.4}{\color{teal}x}^3$$

$$g({\color{teal}x}) = {\color{goldenrod}2}{\color{teal}x} + {\color{teal}x}^3$$

:::

:::

## visualización de polinomios {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3.5em; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 400)

_polys = [
    (0, r'$y = x^0$', 'goldenrod'),
    (1, r'$y = x^1$', '#c0392b'),
    (2, r'$y = x^2$', 'teal'),
    (3, r'$y = x^3$', 'navy'),
    (4, r'$y = x^4$', '#26a69a'),
    (5, r'$y = x^5$', '#111111'),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7.2))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)

for ax, (n, title, color) in zip(axes.flat, _polys):
    ax.plot(x, x**n, color=color, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
    ax.set_title(title, color=color, fontsize=13, pad=5)
    ax.set_xlim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_ylim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.axhline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.9, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.9, zorder=1)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, colors='#666666', length=3)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color('#cccccc')
        spine.set_linewidth(0.9)

fig.tight_layout(pad=1.5)
plt.show()
```

:::

## La intersección del polinomio {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_x_ic  = np.linspace(-2, 2, 400)
_gold_ic = 'goldenrod'
_crim_ic = '#c0392b'

def _setup_ic(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(-2, 2)
    ax.set_ylim(-4, 4)
    ax.set_xticks([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2])
    ax.set_yticks([-4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.axhline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#cccccc', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, colors='#555555', length=3)
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_color('#cccccc')
        sp.set_linewidth(0.9)
```

## Suma de polinomios {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3.5em;"}

::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 2em 2em; gap: 0;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.3em 0;"}
$$\left({3-5\color{teal}x}+\frac{5}{6}{\color{teal}{x^2}}+{12.4\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) + \left({2\color{teal}{x}}+{\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) =$$
:::

:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in data-fragment-index=1 style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 2em 2em; gap: 0;"}

::: {style="margin: -0.3em 0;"}
$$\left(3+\boxed{-5\color{teal}{x}}+\frac{5}{6}{\color{teal}{x^2}}+12.4{\color{teal}{x^3}}\right) + \left(\boxed{2{\color{teal}{x}}}+{\color{teal}x^3}\right) =$$
:::

:::

$$({\color{#c0392b}x^5} + 2{\color{#c0392b}x}{\color{blue}y} + {\color{blue}y^2})({\color{#c0392b}x} - 3{\color{#c0392b}x}{\color{blue}y})$$

:::

```{python}
_x_en = np.linspace(-4, 4, 400)

    ax.plot(_x_en, np.exp(_x_en), color=_gold_en, lw=2.2, zorder=3)
    ax.set_xlim(-4.3, 4.3)

    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.set_xticks([-4, -2, 0, 2, 4])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60])
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
```

## ¿De dónde viene $e$?

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _e_tbl(ax, with_data=False):
    ax.axis('off')
    if with_data:
        rows = [['1',  '2.00000', '0.718282'],
                ['2',  '2.25000', '0.468282'],
                ['5',  '2.48832', '0.229962'],
                ['10', '2.59374', '0.124539']]
    else:
        rows = [['', '', ''], ['', '', ''], ['', '', ''], ['', '', '']]
    tbl = ax.table(
        cellText=rows,
        colLabels=['n', r'$\tilde{e}$', r'$e - \tilde{e}$'],
        cellLoc='center', loc='center',
        bbox=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.88]
    )
    tbl.auto_set_font_size(False)
    _cc = ['navy', 'goldenrod', 'goldenrod']
    for (row, col), cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor('#aaaaaa')
        cell.set_facecolor('none')
        if row == 0:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_cc[col])
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(22)
        elif with_data:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_cc[col])
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(22)
```

## El número $e$ en la naturaleza {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle, Rectangle, Polygon
import numpy as np

_W, _H = 13.5, 5.4

def _bfig(w=_W, h=_H):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w, h))
    ax.set_xlim(0, w); ax.set_ylim(0, h)
    ax.axis('off')
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0); ax.set_facecolor('none')
    return fig, ax

def _bank_icon(ax, cx, cy, s, c, bg):
    """Dibuja un edificio de banco con patches (pedestal, cuerpo con columnas, techo)."""
    # Pedestal
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.48, cy - s*.44), s*.96, s*.10,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Cuerpo
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.38, cy - s*.34), s*.76, s*.38,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Separadores entre columnas (color del fondo de tarjeta = hueco visual)
    for xoff in (-0.13, 0.13):
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx + s*xoff - s*.03, cy - s*.32),
                               s*.06, s*.34, fc=bg, ec='none', zorder=5))
    # Barra base del techo
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - s*.43, cy + s*.02), s*.86, s*.07,
                            fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))
    # Triángulo del techo
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(
        [(cx - s*.43, cy + s*.09), (cx + s*.43, cy + s*.09), (cx, cy + s*.40)],
        fc=c, ec='none', zorder=4))

def _bcard(ax, cx, cy, w, h, bg, rows):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor=bg,
        edgecolor='white', linewidth=2.5, zorder=2))
    _bank_icon(ax, cx, cy + h * 0.39, h * 0.21, c='white', bg=bg)
    for txt, dy, fs, fw, tc in rows:
        ax.text(cx, cy + h * (dy - 0.10), txt, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=round(fs * 24 / 20), fontweight=fw, color=tc, zorder=3)

def _coin(ax, cx, cy, r, color, label, lc='white', fs=15):
    ax.add_patch(Circle((cx, cy), r, color=color, zorder=3, ec='white', lw=2))
    ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color=lc, zorder=4)

def _arr(ax, x1, x2, y, c='#888'):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y), xytext=(x1, y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=2.2))
```

```{python}
fig, ax = _bfig()
ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.35, 'Banco 3: 33.3% de interés cada 4 meses',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=20, color=_RED, fontweight='bold')
for i in range(4):
    c = _GRY if i == 0 else _RED
    lc = '#f1c40f' if i == 3 else 'white'
    _coin(ax, _XS[i], _H/2, 0.52, c, _VALS[i], lc=lc, fs=15)
    ax.text(_XS[i], _H/2 + 0.82, _LABS[i], ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=15, color='#555')
    if i > 0:
        _arr(ax, _XS[i-1] + 0.56, _XS[i] - 0.56, _H/2, c=_RED)
        ax.text((_XS[i-1]+_XS[i])/2, _H/2 + 0.2, r'$\times\,\frac{4}{3}$',
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=15, color=_RED)
ax.text(_W/2, 0.55, r'$(1+\frac{1}{3})^3 \approx 2.37$',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=15, color=_RED, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
_TEAL = '#16a085'
_NXS  = [1.0, 3.3, 5.6, 7.9, 11.0]
_NLABS_TOP = ['Ahora', r'$\frac{1}{n}$ año', r'$\frac{2}{n}$ años',
              r'$\cdots$', '1 año']
_NLABS_BOT = [r'$1$', r'$1+\frac{1}{n}$', r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^2$',
              r'$\cdots$', r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^n$']

def _ntl(ax, highlight=False):
    ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.35, 'Banco n: divide el año en n períodos iguales',
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=24, color=_TEAL, fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate('', xy=(_NXS[-1]+0.7, _H/2), xytext=(_NXS[0]-0.7, _H/2),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#ccc', lw=1.5))
    for i, (cx, lt, lb) in enumerate(zip(_NXS, _NLABS_TOP, _NLABS_BOT)):
        if lt == r'$\cdots$':
            ax.text(cx, _H/2, r'$\cdots$', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=20, color='#aaa')
            ax.text(cx, _H/2 - 0.75, r'$\cdots$', ha='center', va='top',
                    fontsize=20, color='#aaa')
            continue
        lc_val = '#f1c40f' if (highlight and i == len(_NXS)-1) else 'white'
        _coin(ax, cx, _H/2, 0.44, _TEAL, '', fs=11)
        ax.text(cx, _H/2 + 0.68, lt, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=17.5, color='#555')
        ax.text(cx, _H/2 - 0.68, lb, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=17.5,
                color=lc_val if highlight and i == len(_NXS)-1 else _TEAL)

fig, ax = _bfig()
_ntl(ax)
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
_NE_CXS = [1.5, 3.5, 5.5, 7.0, 8.3, 9.3, 10.0, 10.7, 11.4, 12.0, 12.6]
_NE_SZS = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.72, 0.72, 0.52, 0.52, 0.42, 0.35, 0.25, 0.2]
_NE_CLR = ['#7f8c8d','#2980b9','#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9',
           '#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9','#c0392b','#7f8c8d','#2980b9']
_NE_BY  = 2.0
_C1   = (1.5,  1.0,  ['100% de tu dinero',  '1 vez al año'],           '#7f8c8d', 2.3)
_C2   = (3.5,  1.0,  ['1/2 de tu dinero',   '2 veces al año'],          '#2980b9', 2.3)
_C3   = (5.5,  1.0,  ['1/3 de tu dinero',   '3 veces al año'],          '#c0392b', 2.3)
_C12  = (9.3,  0.52, ['1/12 de tu dinero',  '12 veces al año',
                       '(cada mes)'],                                     '#2980b9', 1.9)
_C365 = (12.0, 0.52, ['1/365 de tu dinero', '365 veces al año',
                       '(cada día)'],                                    '#7f8c8d', 1.9)

def _ne_box(ax, cx, y_bot, lines, col, bw=2):
    bh = 0.15 + len(lines) * 0.30
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((cx - bw/2, y_bot), bw, bh,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', fc='white', ec=col, lw=2, zorder=4))
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ax.text(cx, y_bot + bh - 0.08 - j*0.30, ln,
                ha='center', va='top', fontsize=14, color='#333', zorder=5)

def _ne_draw(nb=0, cs=None, qm=False, si=False, nf=0, it=False):
    fig, ax = _bfig()
    sub = 'El Banco al Final del Universo' if it else 'Muchos Bancos'
    stc = '#e91e63' if it else '#2c3e50'
    ax.text(_W/2, _H - 0.15, sub, ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color=stc)
    for i in range(min(nb, len(_NE_CXS))):
        cx, s, col = _NE_CXS[i], _NE_SZS[i], _NE_CLR[i]
        _bank_icon(ax, cx, _NE_BY, s, col, 'white')
    if nb >= 6 and not qm:
        ax.text(13.1, _NE_BY, '···', ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=14, color='#bbb')
    if cs:
        for (cx, s, lines, col, bw) in cs:
            top = _NE_BY + s * 0.50
            ax.plot([cx, cx], [top, top + 0.22], color=col, lw=1.5, zorder=3)
            _ne_box(ax, cx, top + 0.22, lines, col, bw)
    if qm:
        ax.add_patch(Circle((12.85, _NE_BY + 0.5), 0.32,
                            fc='#f5f5f5', ec='#555', lw=2, zorder=3))
        ax.text(12.85, _NE_BY + 0.5, '?', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#555', zorder=4)
    if si:
        icx, icy = 11.8, 4.5
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((icx-1.0, icy-0.65), 2.0, 1.30,
                               fc='#fce4ec', ec='#e91e63', lw=2.5,
                               linestyle='--', zorder=3))
        _bank_icon(ax, icx, icy+0.10, 0.55, '#e91e63', '#fce4ec')
        ax.text(icx, icy-0.40, 'Banco', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#e91e63', zorder=5)
        ax.text(icx, icy-0.57, r'$n\to\infty$', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=10, color='#e91e63', zorder=5)
        for bi in [0, 5, 10]:
            if bi < nb and bi < len(_NE_CXS):
                bx = _NE_CXS[bi]; bs = _NE_SZS[bi]
                ax.plot([bx, icx], [_NE_BY + bs*0.44, icy - 0.65],
                        color='#e91e63', lw=1.2, linestyle='--',
                        alpha=0.35, zorder=2)
    _FD = [
        (r'$(1+1)^1 = 2$',                  '#7f8c8d'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{2})^2 = 2.25$',     '#2980b9'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{3})^3 = 2.37$',     '#c0392b'),
        (r'$(1+\frac{1}{12})^{12} = 2.613$','#e67e22'),
    ]
    for k in range(nf):
        ax.text(1.5 + k*3.0, 0.42, _FD[k][0], ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=13, color=_FD[k][1])
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
    return fig
```

## Convergencia a $e$ {.title-line}

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3em;"}
::: {.r-stack style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; width: 100%;"}

::: {style="background: white; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'hide'
_ROWS_PART = [
    ['1',  '2.00000'],
    ['2',  '2.25000'],
    ['3',  '2.37037'],
    ['12', '2.61304'],
]
_ROWS_FULL = _ROWS_PART + [
    ['100',    '2.70481'],
    ['1 000',  '2.71692'],
    ['10 000', '2.71815'],
    [r'$\infty$', r'$e = 2.71828...$'],
]

def _ctbl(ax, rows, hl=False):
    ax.axis('off')
    tbl = ax.table(
        cellText=rows,
        colLabels=['n', r'$(1+1/n)^n$'],
        cellLoc='center', loc='center',
        bbox=[0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.94]
    )
    tbl.auto_set_font_size(False)
    for (r, c), cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor('#cccccc')
        cell.set_facecolor('none')
        if r == 0:
            cell.get_text().set_color(_TEAL)
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(15)
        else:
            last = hl and r == len(rows)
            cell.get_text().set_color('#e91e63' if last else '#333')
            cell.get_text().set_fontsize(15)
            cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold' if last else 'normal')

fig, (axL, axR) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(_W, _H))
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
axL.set_facecolor('none'); axR.set_facecolor('none')
_ctbl(axL, _ROWS_PART)
axR.axis('off')
axR.text(0.5, 0.62, r'¿Hacia dónde converge?',
         ha='center', va='center', transform=axR.transAxes,
         fontsize=20, color='#555', style='italic')
axR.text(0.5, 0.38, r'$(1+\frac{1}{n})^n \to\, ?$',
         ha='center', va='center', transform=axR.transAxes,
         fontsize=20, color=_TEAL, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _ln_fig(dot_xy=None):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.0, 7.5))
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    x = np.linspace(0.001, 4, 3000)
    ax.plot(x, np.log(x), color='goldenrod', linewidth=2.5, zorder=2)
    ax.set_xlim(-1, 4)
    ax.set_ylim(-7, 2)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#444', linewidth=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    if dot_xy is not None:
        ax.scatter([dot_xy[0]], [dot_xy[1]], s=320,
                   color='goldenrod', alpha=0.55, zorder=5, edgecolors='none')
    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _lr_fig(show_yx=False):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.0, 7.5))
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
    ax.set_facecolor('none')
    x_e = np.linspace(-4, np.log(4), 400)
    ax.plot(x_e, np.exp(x_e), color='goldenrod', lw=2.5, label='exp(x)')
    x_l = np.linspace(0.018, 4, 400)
    ax.plot(x_l, np.log(x_l), color='#c0392b', lw=2.5, label='ln(x)')
    if show_yx:
        ax.plot([-4, 4], [-4, 4], color='#888', lw=1.5, ls='--', zorder=1)
    ax.set_xlim(-4, 4); ax.set_ylim(-4, 4)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8); ax.axvline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, framealpha=0, loc='upper left')
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

## Logaritmos {.title-line}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def _log3_fig():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 7.8))
    fig.patch.set_alpha(0); ax.set_facecolor('none')
    x = np.linspace(0.008, 4, 600)
    ax.plot(x, np.log2(x),  color='goldenrod', lw=2.3, label=r'$\log_2(x)$')
    ax.plot(x, np.log10(x), color='#c0392b',   lw=2.3, label=r'$\log_{10}(x)$')
    ax.plot(x, np.log(x),   color='#2471a3',   lw=2.3, label=r'$\log_e(x)$')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 4); ax.set_ylim(-6, 2)
    ax.set_xlabel('x', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('y', fontsize=10, rotation=0, labelpad=12)
    ax.axhline(0, color='#444', lw=0.8)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)
    ax.legend(fontsize=10, framealpha=0, loc='lower right')
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax
```

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0.4em 3em 0.4em 0.5em; gap: 0.5em; align-items: center;"}
